title: A .def file writer
description:
Generate a module-definition file from a list of functions.

```
LIBRARY mathlib
EXPORTS
    add         @1
    multiply    @2
    version     @3 NONAME
```
hints: Two `std::set`s, one of names and one of ordinals, find duplicates as you go: `insert` returns whether it was new (lesson 1.04).
`NONAME` exports only by ordinal, so a caller must use `GetProcAddress(module, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(3))`.
requirements: Read the list of `(name, ordinal, hidden)` entries and print the `.def` text.
Refuse duplicate names and duplicate ordinals with a message.
stretch: Read the entries from a text file instead.
